mapper.select:
SELECT b.id, b.product_id AS productId, b.sort_order AS sortOrder, b.is_active AS isActive,
p.name, p.short_description AS shortDescription, p.description, p.brand, p.price, p.subscription_price AS subscriptionPrice,
( SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl
FROM banners b INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = b.product_id WHERE b.is_active = 1 AND p.is_active = 1 ORDER BY b.sort_order ASC, b.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banners ( product_id, sort_order, is_active ) VALUES ( #{product_id}, #{sort_order}, 1 )
